maintenance_led.reason: Revenue mainly from recurring proxy/investor communications and trade-processing technology services, not repair, maintenance or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Clients are banks, broker-dealers, asset managers and funds paying for proxy, communications and trading technology; private financial industry.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly organically via proxy, post-trade processing and technology; acquisitions such as Itiviti and AdvisorStream are only occasional.

mission_critical.reason: Embedded trade processing, proxy and regulatory communications platforms are hard to replace; switching risks downtime and regulatory compliance failures.
